verdict.rationale: Foreloop's agent proposes tasks from feedback rather than creating them outright, and the CLI separates out "open tasks whose contract is approved". Together these imply an approval gate on task scope before work is picked up. The evidence is only a CLI comment and a one-line description, with no documented review or approval workflow. missing for 10: documentation of how a product manager reviews and edits a proposed task's scope, the approval action itself and who can perform it, any rule that blocks work before approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can review and approve the scope of a task before any work begins on it

citations.quote: foreloop tasks ready             # open tasks whose contract is approved
its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
